# Fact table: tf_sales (5 measures, 11 filters)

    "tf_sales",
    measures=[

        {"name": "hits", "sql_type": "bigint", "nullable": False},
        {"name": "revenue", "sql_type": "numeric", "nullable": True, "column": "revenue_total"},

        {"name": "balance", "sql_type": "numeric", "nullable": False, "additivity": {"kind": "semi_additive", "over": "day", "using": "last", "entity": ["account_id"]}},
    ],
    dimensions={"name": "data", "paths": [{"name": "status", "json_path": "data->>'status'", "data_type": "text"}]},
    denormalized_filters=[
        {"name": "account_id", "sql_type": "bigint", "indexed": True},

        {"name": "day", "sql_type": "date", "indexed": True},

        {"name": "region", "sql_type": "text", "indexed": True},

        {"name": "client_ip", "sql_type": "inet", "indexed": True},
